title: Split PDF
about: Split PDF is a focused BROBEX Image Studio tool for document conversion and PDF handling. Extract selected PDF pages into a new file. It is intended for people who need a practical way to prepare, inspect, or transform digital content without navigating an unrelated editor. The exact result depends on the source file, the controls exposed by this page, and the processing method used by the current implementation. Review the workspace before selecting a file so the input and expected output are clear.
steps: Review the formats and file limits shown by the workspace before selecting source documents.
Choose the file or files that the current tool supports. For multi-file tasks, confirm their order where the interface provides ordering controls.
Set any page, output, or document options displayed by the tool. Do not assume options that are not present in the current workspace.
Run the conversion or document operation. Processing may depend on browser support or an external integration; an unavailable integration is identified rather than simulated.
Inspect the resulting document or page preview when available, then use the provided download control. Open the downloaded file in a compatible viewer to confirm layout and content.
capabilities: The registered processing method for this tool is pdf-lib (browser). The tool accepts the formats listed in the workspace. Its intended task is extract selected pdf pages into a new file. Only controls and output choices visible in the current workspace should be treated as supported. The tool does not silently add unrelated editing features, and an operation that needs a provider cannot be considered available until that integration is configured and tested.
benefits: This workflow can make a repetitive document conversion and PDF handling task more approachable by keeping the relevant action in one place. It may be useful when preparing images for websites, forms, documents, presentations, archives, or everyday sharing, depending on the selected operation. Working from a copy is recommended whenever the original file is important. A quick review of the output helps catch quality changes, unsupported content, or formatting differences before the file is used elsewhere.
limitations: Supported input types are the formats listed in the workspace. Browser processing can be affected by device memory, browser version, image dimensions, and file complexity. This tool is registered as browser-based, but its provider-dependent behavior must still be checked against the actual workspace before relying on it. Conversion and compression can change quality, metadata, transparency, color handling, or layout. Always verify the exported file in its intended destination. BROBEX cannot guarantee acceptance by third-party services or official application portals.

faqs.question: What does Split PDF do?
faqs.answer: Extract selected PDF pages into a new file.

faqs.question: Which files can I use?
faqs.answer: Use only supported files. The registered accepted types are the formats listed in the workspace; the workspace may also show additional upload limits or browser restrictions.

faqs.question: How do I get the best result?
faqs.answer: Start with a clear, correctly oriented source file and review the available settings before processing. Inspect the actual output rather than relying only on the preview or filename.

faqs.question: Will the result always match the original quality?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Editing, conversion, resizing, and compression can affect detail, color, transparency, metadata, or layout. Keep an untouched copy of important source files.

faqs.question: Is processing available right now?
faqs.answer: The registry identifies this tool as browser-based. Availability still depends on the controls and processing path currently present in its workspace; do not treat a result as complete unless the tool produces it.
